note: One relations.toml edge at each grain below the classification grain, as the old test wrote one resolved edge per grain: register (old 2001, 'Register transition'), variable (2001, 'Variable transition'), variant (endpoints only: the artifact keeps no variant year, note or description) and a variant-scoped representation (2000, 'Column transition', old variant 'individuals' and columns OldColumn -> oneColumn). The variant edge starts at SYD's synthesized `_default` variant: the old test's claim that a variant reference keeps the reserved `_default` slug. The old resolved notes ('curated:register' ...) were the writer's input; a build writes a curated variable or representation edge's note as `curated:slug_toml` (the register grain stores no note) and the edge's own `note` as its description (compile_declared_metadata).
fails_if: `prepare_resolved_metadata` writes a register or variable edge without its effective year or description, a variable edge without its note, a variant edge without its endpoints, or a representation edge without its variant scope; or `ResolvedVariantRef` refuses the reserved `_default` variant slug, so the build fails on the variant edge
